text:
ravi: Heads-up — I tried the JS SDK quickstart in Deno and Bun for a partner demo and hit multiple small DX issues.
mai: what came up?
ravi: Deno errors on the default README import: 'Uncaught Error: package.json exports do not contain ./deno'. TS also complains about 'no default export' when using the Node-style default import.
joel: yup, Deno expects explicit ESM entrypoints or a deno-specific export path. Our README examples are Node-centric.
mai: Bun quirks too?
ravi: Yeah — older Bun builds sometimes lack crypto.subtle so auth signing fails. Also Bun/edge response.body shapes differ and our body parser throws on instanceof checks.
joel: short plan: 1) add an explicit 'redwood/deno' export with a distilled ESM bundle and d.ts, 2) create a tiny runtime-adapters module (isDeno/isBun/isNode, fetchNormalize, subtleShim), 3) update quickstarts with examples/deno-quickstart (deno.json + import_map) and a bun note.
mai: agree. For package.json exports we can add: {"./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs", ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}} then README shows `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'`.
joel: subtleShim idea: dynamic import fallback only when globalThis.crypto?.subtle is missing so tree-shaking keeps Node bundles small. Example: `const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle ?? (await import('./shims/subtle.js')).subtle`.
mai: for fetch differences do: try `await response.json()` then `await response.arrayBuffer()` before low-level stream ops. That should handle Bun/edge variants.
ravi: CI: add matrix job running sample apps on node(18/20), deno(>=1.34), bun nightly. ci-bot: nightly deno sample job failed: https://ci.internal/quickstarts/222 (shows exports resolve error)
joel: I'll open the PR for the deno export + examples. ravi — can you own runtime-adapters + subtle shim tests?
ravi: yeah I'll take that and mock missing subtle and weird stream shapes. I'll also add a short troubleshooting blurb to the README: "If you see 'exports do not contain ./deno', use `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` or upgrade to SDK >= x.y.z".
mai: sounds good. ci-bot: created issue #1203: "JS SDK: Deno/Bun runtime compatibility - deno entry, runtime adapters, webcrypto fallback, fetch normalization" assigned to joel,ravi.
joel: thanks — will try to get a patch out today before the partner demo.
